provenance_note: The reference corpus was authored by another agent from HSE HSG250, the tool specification and its own time arithmetic without access to this code; this run recomputes every check from the shipping build.
reference: Scenario corpus for a single permit-to-work review, built from HSE HSG250 (roles Table 1, Figure 1 essential permit elements, suspension paras 19-20, handover para 23, hand-back para 24, responsibilities paras 34-40) plus spec 02/00 acceptance criteria. Covers complete permits for all six built-in types, one-missing-control and conflicting-role cases, lifecycle/suspension/handover/close-out, measurement completeness, staleness and limit boundaries with user-entered site values, validity ordering and duration boundaries, refusal of bad exchange/pack input, and insufficient-data cases. Time arithmetic and 16 randomized vectors (seed 20260916) come from ref.py (stdlib, epoch-second arithmetic). Inputs are tool-neutral descriptions in the README vocabulary; the harness must map them to the tool state.
reference_citations: HSE, HSG250 Guidance on permit-to-work systems: a guide for the petroleum, chemical and allied industries, 2005, ISBN 978 0 7176 2943 5, https://www.hse.gov.uk/pubns/priced/hsg250.pdf (paras 9-12, 19-24, 29-30, 34, 37-40, 49, 54; Table 1; Figure 1)
tools.petrov.re spec 02 Permit-to-Work Studio (MVP scope, conflicts, acceptance criteria) and spec 00-common section 0.5 (insufficient data / no safe-looking result), Appendix B (stable IDs)
First-principles time ordering and arithmetic: bench/permitworkstudio/ref.py
tolerance: Categorical outcomes exact (rule ID present/absent, verdict boolean, refused). Minute ages exact (abs 0 min) because inputs are whole minutes and the rule is a comparison, not a computation; durations rel 1e-9 (floating-point division of integer seconds only). Threshold comparisons use 'older than' / 'outside' / 'longer than' literally, so equality is on the passing side; those equality cases are marked disputable.

not_benchmarked.Profile control identity: Exact identity of built-in profile controls and which are prerequisite/ongoing/close-out/advisory (pack is illustrative; no independent source) - cases say 'any one prerequisite control'. PTW-R-011 (advisory control) not covered.
not_benchmarked.ISO 45001 competence clause: ISO 45001:2018 clause 7.2 text could not be read (paywalled); competence case grounded in HSG250 instead.
not_benchmarked.Electrical and height standards: EN 50110-1, GS38, EN 13374/795/363 content not read; no electrical/height clause-specific expectations.
not_benchmarked.Exchange alias mappings: Exchange alias mappings (README contract A/B) not independently derivable; only refusal, unknown-status and open-step principles tested. PTW-R-017, PTW-R-019 not covered.
not_benchmarked.Report, layout and storage: Printable/PDF content (no machine keys), 390 px layout, localisation, localStorage and round-trip - UI/QA properties, not reference outcomes.
not_benchmarked.Time boundaries and SIMOPS: Behaviour at exact equality of review time with validity start/end; time zones; SIMOPS and multi-shift history (out of scope per README).
not_benchmarked.Completeness percentage: permit_completeness percentage: no independent definition of the metric.
not_benchmarked.Items supplied by the adapter: Profile items the corpus does not represent (specialist roles such as standby rescue, isolation authority and excavation inspector; measurements other than flammable gas, oxygen and the dead test) are supplied by the adapter in complete, valid form and say so in each case note.
